greeting.text: Not now. Not now. Hold the gate.

before.text: They came for the crystal, and we are still here, and that is all anyone will remember. Thank you. Stand by the hall; I do not believe it is over.

after.text: She took it. A woman I have known since she was a girl, and she took it as if I were furniture. Go after her, Aldric. Go after both of them. I will be here, with a broken city and a very long list of things I should have done.
